stages.label: Approved by council (zoning or subdivision)
stages.source: The City of Cambridge publishes no zoning or subdivision application data on its open data portal.

stages.label: Site plan approved
stages.source: Site Plans (City of Cambridge GeoHub), City of Cambridge, https://www.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=a73c7cb57adc4384ad1b3765abfa00ff, retrieved 2026-11-14, City of Cambridge Open Data Licence v2.1 (https://www.cambridge.ca/mayor-city-council-government/open-data/): residential or mixed residential/commercial site plans received 2022-01-01 to 2026-03-20 with status Approved. The data give no unit counts.

stages.label: Building permit issued
stages.source: Building Permits (City of Cambridge GeoHub), City of Cambridge, https://www.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=9093dbbced88444fb61134187737c547, retrieved 2026-11-14, City of Cambridge Open Data Licence v2.1 (https://www.cambridge.ca/mayor-city-council-government/open-data/): new units on residential permits issued 2022-01-01 to 2026-11-06 (cancelled or revoked permits left out).

stages.label: Under construction
stages.source: Building Permits (City of Cambridge GeoHub), City of Cambridge, https://www.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=9093dbbced88444fb61134187737c547, retrieved 2026-11-14, City of Cambridge Open Data Licence v2.1 (https://www.cambridge.ca/mayor-city-council-government/open-data/): permits issued 2022-01-01 to 2026-11-06 that are still open. Status Issued or similar, not dormant, not closed, no occupancy yet. Foundation-only permits are left out because their units repeat on the full permit.

stages.label: Completed
stages.source: Building Permits (City of Cambridge GeoHub), City of Cambridge, https://www.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=9093dbbced88444fb61134187737c547, retrieved 2026-11-14, City of Cambridge Open Data Licence v2.1 (https://www.cambridge.ca/mayor-city-council-government/open-data/): new units on permits closed after final inspection in the window, plus permits marked 'Occupancy Permitted - Not Closed' (2022-01-01 to 2026-11-09). Date used: FINALDATE on closed permits (cancelled permits also carry a FINALDATE and are left out). Includes 228 units on 222 permits issued since 2022-01-01 that are marked finished but carry no finish date.

timeBetween.note: Not measurable from public data: planning approvals and building permits are published in separate lists with no shared file number, so the same project can't be followed from approval to permit.

Median days from permit issued to final inspection or occupancy, over 2,922 residential permits finished 2022-01-01 to 2026-11-06 (the same permit followed across both dates). For permits with 10 or more new units: 752 days (11 permits). Only finished permits count, so slow projects still under way are not in it yet; most permits are single homes and basement units, which finish fastest.

target.label: Ontario's housing target for Cambridge: 19,000 new homes from 2022 to 2031. The province counts 3,023 homes toward it from 2022 through 2024. In 2024: 741 against a 2024 target of 1,583 (Not met). Source: "Ontario’s housing supply: January – December 2024", https://data.ontario.ca/dataset/ontario-s-housing-supply-progress (Open Government Licence – Ontario).

hardToTrack: Approved but no building permit yet: no city publishes a list that links a council approval (zoning, subdivision or site plan) to the building permits that follow, so nobody outside city hall can count the homes waiting between approval and permit.

Construction start: permits show the day a permit was issued, not the day work began. Here 'under construction' means a permit issued since 2022 with no final inspection or occupancy yet; some of those may not have started, and some may have lapsed.

Units in permits vs units built: a permit's unit count is what was proposed. The cities don't publish how many units were finally built, so completed units here are the permit's units on permits marked finished.
One building, several permits: big projects can be split into phases or permits (and townhouse blocks into one permit per unit), so 'projects' counts permits, not buildings.
Who the homes are for: permits don't say whether units are rentals, condos or affordable homes.
Finish dates: a permit's final inspection or closing date can come months or years after people moved in, so permits 'completed' in a period are not the same as CMHC's completions for that period.
Council approvals: Cambridge publishes site plans (without unit counts) but no zoning or subdivision applications as open data.
Starts and completions by city: CMHC counts housing starts and completions for the whole Kitchener-Cambridge-Waterloo area (including Woolwich and North Dumfries), not for each city.
